title: What Is Claude Code? A Plain-English Guide for Developers
summary: Claude Code is Anthropic's AI coding CLI that delegates tasks to Claude. Learn what it does, how it works, and what's new in 2026 (dynamic workflows, ultracode).
body_markdown: Dynamic workflows let Claude write an orchestration script for large tasks. Claude spawns parallel subagents — each with a clean context window and a focused piece of the work. Results are verified and synthesized before they surface to you. Dynamic workflows went GA on June 10, 2026, and are on by default for Max, Team, and Enterprise plans.
